description: Base64File đã chuyển sang dùng media-sniff (t-34ae.2, commit 6c32772): đuôi file mặc định giờ là .txt/.json/.html thay vì .bin, và HEIC/TIFF/PSD không còn được hiện preview ảnh. Hành vi này chưa có browser-check nào phủ. Cần thêm kiểm tra vào scripts/checks/base64-*.mjs.

handoff.summary: All three tasks are done and committed locally on main as 5 commits on top of d2c3820. Nothing is pushed, and .alp/tasks was not touched. Its 3 modified files in the working tree are main's. Commits (oldest first): - ec97a14 t-9d12, scripts/checks/base64-a.mjs: browser checks for Base64 File. Base64 → File: raw text/JSON/HTML/TIFF get file.txt/.json/.html/.tiff (both button and placeholder), the real JSON download is named file.json, and HEIC/TIFF data URLs show no . File → Base64: HEIC/PSD uploads declared image/* show no . PNG is the positive control in both directions. - f49fe8d t-a363, src/lib/charset.ts, src/lib/charset.test.ts, src/tools/base64/Base64Charset.tsx: export the existing codePointCount (defaults from=0, to=length; body unchanged) and use it in place of [...dec.text].length. Unit tests compare it with [...text].length for surrogate pairs, lone high/low surrogates, a reversed pair, a trailing high surrogate, and range semantics. - cae735a t-076d, src/lib/charset.ts, charset.test.ts, Base64Charset.tsx, scripts/checks/base64-b.mjs: UTF-16 hint, unit tests, browser check, screenshot. - e62aee3 t-9d12 (review follow-up), base64-a.mjs: wait for the JSON state before the download click. - 20d84af t-076d (review follow-up), the same 4 files as cae735a: copy fixes, documented trade-off plus a pinning test, the vacuous test case dropped, the browser check waits for the decoded value. Per task: - t-9d12: done. Discrimination is proven, not argued: I ran the new checks against a 6c32772^ build (a temporary detached worktree with the current check harness, since removed). Result: 9 FAILs, one for every non-control case (text/JSON/HTML/raw TIFF detected as octet-stream; HEIC/TIFF data URLs named file.bin and given 1 ; the JSON download named file.bin; HEIC/PSD uploads given 1 ). PNG controls pass on both builds. - t-a363: done. - t-076d: done, on the HINT branch. "Decode as" already offers UTF-16LE and UTF-16BE (they are in CHARSETS), so I added no new option. The detector is not loosened. looksLikeCjk now delegates to a shared readCjkUnits scan that is logically identical; the reviewer fuzzed 300k inputs and found 0 detectCharset differences against d2c3820. The new utf16CjkAlternatives(bytes, detection) shows the hint only for an auto-detect, low-confidence, non-UTF-16 guess on even-length input of 4 bytes or more, when a byte order decodes as valid UTF-16 made only of CJK and printable-ASCII units, with at least 2 CJK units and at least 50% CJK, over a 64 KB sample. It is memoized. The notice then adds: "It may also be UTF-16 without a byte order mark: as UTF-16LE it reads “日本語…” [Decode as UTF-16LE]". This uses the btn btn-small pattern from Base64Validate, and the button sets "Decode as". Gate deviation from the brief, with its reason: I gated on whether the UTF-16 reading is plausible, not on "many U+FFFD / legacy-CJK guess". A probe showed short UTF-16 CJK decodes in legacy charsets with 0 U+FFFD, and about half of it is guessed as windows-125x, so the suggested gate would miss most target cases. The reviewer measured that gating on a legacy-CJK guess would drop 23 of 53 target hits. The hint shows a preview, so the user can judge the reading. Browser check: the hint shows for short UTF-16LE Japanese, one click decodes it, and no hint shows for an EUC-KR sentence. It fails on a pre-hint build ("no UTF-16LE hint for short UTF-16 Japanese"). Screenshots (t-076d): .artifacts/screenshots/base64-charset-utf16-hint-light.png and -dark.png. I checked them visually. Reviewer: claude:opus, read-only, assignment alp-child-fd5af36b-2b43-4d82-b1eb-c8603b899b88. Codex was paused on its usage limit until 05:35Z, so I switched to Claude under the user rule. Verdict: pass_with_findings, all 4 criteria passed. Findings: 1 medium and 4 low. - Medium (the hint also fires on most short, correctly detected legacy CJK, e.g. Shift_JIS 日本語 previews as “鏺陻質”): accepted as a trade-off, as the reviewer recommended. The docstring now documents it, a unit test pins it, and the copy reads as a continuation of "if the text looks wrong". - Low, "or" separator between two byte orders: fixed. - Low, stale-read waits in both checks: fixed. - Low, vacuous "under 4 bytes" test: removed. - Low, focus drops to after the click: NOT fixed. The shared Select in src/components/controls.tsx takes no ref, which is outside my scope. I made no re-review of the small follow-up delta (e62aee3 and 20d84af, 20 lines); main should look at it.

verification: Final HEAD 20d84af: `pnpm check` exited 0 (typecheck, lint, vitest: Test Files 15 passed, Tests 339 passed; build; smoke: OK (35 tool routes))

Final HEAD 20d84af: `pnpm browser` exited 0 with 0 FAIL lines: 'browser-check: OK (35 tool routes + home + 404, 0 console/CSP errors)'. New lines: 11 'ok file: …' (PNG control, plain text→file.txt, JSON→file.json, HTML→file.html, raw TIFF→file.tiff, HEIC/TIFF data URL no preview, JSON download saved as file.json, upload png preview, upload heic/psd no preview), 'ok charset: no UTF-16 hint for EUC-KR text', 'ok charset: UTF-16LE hint for short Japanese, one click decodes it'

Discrimination: the same check modules run against a 6c32772^ build gave 'browser-check: 11 problem(s)', including 9 'FAIL file: …' (every non-control case) and 'FAIL charset: no UTF-16LE hint for short UTF-16 Japanese' (the 11th is the hint screenshot setup timing out). PNG controls were ok on both builds
pnpm vitest run src/lib/charset.test.ts: 74 passed (after the follow-ups: 3 cases changed, total 74)

Reviewer (claude:opus): 300k-input fuzz found 0 detectCharset differences between d2c3820 and cae735a; 200k-string fuzz found 0 codePointCount mismatches against [...s].length and against the old function on ranges; utf16CjkAlternatives took 1.24 ms on a 320 KB input
risks: The UTF-16 hint is a deliberately loose gate. It also appears for short, correctly detected legacy double-byte CJK (the reviewer measured 51 of 84 short Shift_JIS/EUC-KR/GBK/EUC-JP/Big5 strings) and for some Latin-1 text with paired accented letters, e.g. windows-1252 'café'. The preview shows garbled CJK in those cases, and a non-reader could mistake it for real text. The copy is phrased as an option ('It may also be…'), and detection itself is unchanged.

Keyboard focus drops to <body> after the hint button is clicked, because the hint unmounts. A fix needs a ref or focus support in the shared Select (src/components/controls.tsx), which is out of scope.
No independent re-review of the 20-line follow-up delta (e62aee3, 20d84af); pnpm check and pnpm browser pass on it.
Base64 File checks use synthetic header-only TIFF/HEIC/PSD fixtures, not real image files. They cover sniffing and preview gating, not decoding.
discovered: Charset detector, very short input: GBK '中文' (4 bytes) is guessed as KOI8-R. Short legacy-CJK scoring is weak below about 6 bytes (src/lib/charset.ts detectCharset/scoreCharset).

Unverified, possibly Node-ICU-only: in my Node probe, TextDecoder('euc-jp') decoded the bytes 22 8c 22 8c (UTF-16LE '谢谢') to '""' with invalid=0. The 0x8C bytes vanished instead of becoming U+FFFD. Worth checking in Chrome; if it reproduces, decodeBytes under-reports invalid sequences for that case.
a11y: the hint button unmounts on click and focus is lost. Fixing it would need the shared Select to forward a ref (src/components/controls.tsx).

The working tree is clean apart from main's 3 modified .alp/tasks files, which I did not touch. The temporary worktree at /tmp/lead-scratch/old was removed. No peer wrote anything; all implementation is lead-authored and needs main's review.
